title: Android push notification not received after new email

source.issueTitle: Notification not received on Android mobile

knownBehavior: Some Android users report that they do not receive push notifications in the mobile application after receiving new emails.
The current observed behavior is that no push notification is displayed on the user's Android device when a new email is received, even though the mobile application is installed.
expectedBehavior: When a user receives a new email, the Android mobile application should immediately send a push notification to the user's device.
This expected behavior applies according to the app's notification settings and the operating system permissions.
If notifications are disabled at OS level or for the app's relevant notification channel, the absence of a notification is considered compliant behavior.
acceptanceCriteria: Each time a user receives a new email, if the Android mobile application is installed and notifications are enabled for the app and the relevant notification channel, the user receives a push notification on their device.
The behavior should be verified on supported Android OS versions and devices.
If notifications are disabled at OS level or for the app's notification channel, the application does not send a notification and this is compliant behavior.
safeResponseStrategy: Explain that the expected behavior is to receive a push notification when a new email arrives, if notifications are enabled for the app and allowed by Android.
First check whether notifications are enabled at Android OS level, app level, and notification channel level.
If the user is on Android 13 or later, ask whether the runtime notification permission has been granted.
If notification settings are enabled, collect technical details needed to qualify the issue.
Stay factual and avoid promising an immediate fix.
questionsToAskFirst: Are you using the Android mobile application?
Are notifications enabled for the app in Android settings?
If you are using Android 13 or later, has the notification permission been granted to the app?
Is the relevant notification channel enabled?
Which Android version are you using?
Which app version are you using?
Does the issue happen for every new email or only in some cases?
Does it affect only one device/user or several devices/users?
recommendedFirstAnswer: I understand that you are not receiving Android push notifications when a new email arrives. The expected behavior is that a push notification appears if the mobile app is installed and notifications are allowed by Android and by the app's notification settings. Could you first check whether notifications are enabled for the app in Android settings, and if you are on Android 13 or later, whether the notification permission has been granted?
ifUserConfirmsNotificationsEnabled: Thanks for checking. To qualify the issue, could you share your Android version, device model, app version, and whether the missing notification happens for every new email or only in specific cases?
doNotClaim: Do not say that the issue is fixed.
Do not say that a fix is already available.
Do not promise a resolution timeline.
Do not claim that a support team is already investigating.
Do not blame the user or state that the phone is misconfigured.
Do not say the issue is caused by Android 13 unless the user's OS version and permission status confirm it.
Do not ask for logs first unless the basic notification permissions and app/device details have already been checked.
